lines: Four generations on the same three feet of the Lower Market.
Coast goods coming in cheap now. Cheaper than I can buy them.
Somebody is paying the carriage, and when somebody pays your carriage
they are not being kind, they are buying the road.

sw_house_e_child: I am not allowed a Kin until I can keep the stall rent jar full for a year.
It has been full since spring. He keeps not noticing.
You would not like to mention it to him? On your way out? Casually?
